jds.title: Operations Intern
jds.raw_text:
Operations Intern 
 
About the Role  
We are looking for dynamic and motivated Interns who are eager to learn and gain hands-on experience across 
Business Enhancement, Vendor interaction and Onboarding, Logistics and Inter-Department operations. This 
internship is designed to give you 360° exposure to business operations while allowing you to explore which field 
excites you the most. This internship is designed to help you discover your strengths across different business 
functions, while preparing you for full-time opportunities.  
Key Responsibilities  
• Assist the operations team in planning and execution of daily task and projects.  
• Maintain reports and ensure smooth day-to-day functioning.  
• Collaborate with different departments for cross-functional learning and efficiency.  
• Support in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational productivity.  
• Monitor resources, timelines, and deliverables to ensure compliance with organizational goals.  
 
Who Can Apply  
• Fresh graduates or final-year students from Business, Management, or Commerce background.  
• Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.  
• Ability to multitask and take ownership of responsibilities.  
• Interest in building a long-term career in Operations.  
 
Why Join Us?  
• Exposure to production, Logistics, and business operations.  
• Steep learning curve and mentorship from professionals.  
• Opportunity for career progression into managerial roles based on performance.

structured_requirements.core: Plan and execute daily tasks; maintain reports; cross-department coordination; process improvement; monitor resources and timelines; vendor onboarding and logistics

jds.title: Business Development Executive Intern
jds.raw_text:
Business Development Executive Intern 
 
About the Role  
We are looking for an energetic and enthusiastic BDE Intern who is passionate about business development and 
operations, enjoys interacting with people, and contributes to strengthening brand visibility across both B2B and 
B2C channels. In this role, you will directly connect with business clients and retail customers, highlighting product 
or service features and driving sales growth through strategic engagement.  
As a key representative in the B2B and B2C space, you will focus on building long-term consumer relationships, 
ensuring personalized brand experiences, and maximizing indirect sales conversions. This is an excellent opportunity 
for young professionals to build a rewarding career across multiple sales ecosystems.  
 
Key Responsibilities  
• Assist in planning and coordinating daily business operations.  
• Approach customers and business partners to explain product offerings and value propositions across B2B 
and B2C segments.  
• Assist in marketing and promotional activities.  
• Collaborate with the sales team to generate leads and build client relationships.  
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to improve efficiency and promote innovation.  
• Identify and suggest new business opportunities for company growth.  
• Prepare business reports and track performance. 
 
 Who Can Apply  
• Fresh graduates or final-year students from Business, Management, or Commerce background.  
• Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.  
• Ability to multitask and take ownership of responsibilities.  
• Interest in building a long-term career in Business Development, Marketing, and Operations.  
 
Why Join Us?  
• Exposure to production, sales, marketing, and business operations.  
• Steep learning curve and mentorship from professionals.  
• Opportunity for career progression into managerial roles based on performance in short span.

structured_requirements.core: Approach B2B & B2C clients; explain offerings and value propositions; generate leads and build client relationships; marketing and promotions; identify opportunities; prepare business reports
